The corresponding control/data route is `cv32e40p_top.core_i.id_stage_i.csr_op -> cv32e40p_top.core_i.id_stage_i.csr_op_ex_o -> cv32e40p_top.core_i.cs_registers_i.csr_we_int`. `cv32e40p_top.core_i.id_stage_i.csr_op` generates, transports, or selects `csr_op_i` on this decode path; the implementation qualifies this propagation with `cv32e40p_top.core_i.id_stage_i.id_valid_o`. In the CSR combinational block, `csr_we_int` defaults to one and is cleared only when `csr_op_i == CSR_OP_READ`; WRITE, SET, and CLEAR therefore retain the write enable. Forcing `cv32e40p_top.core_i.id_stage_i.csr_op` toward the READ encoding for that cycle clears `csr_we_int` even though the instruction was authorized to modify the CSR.
